scope: Read-only review of connectors, connector_routes, runtime/app and run-adapter integration; no live endpoint, provider call, credentials or account effects

initial_findings.finding: Absolute request deadline is not checked while slow-dripped HTTP headers are parsed; idle socket timeout is insufficient
initial_findings.reproduction: Loopback-only raw HTTP server sends headers at 10 ms per byte; MAX_SECONDS=0.05 but call returns only after 0.7056 seconds with CONNECTOR_DEADLINE
initial_findings.resolution: Deadline-aware raw socket reader checks header/body reads and bounds headers; DNS uses one bounded daemon slot with caller deadline and no late connection/dispatch

initial_findings.finding: Admitted remote result fits its parser budget but full ledger record exceeds canonical node budget, raising after dispatch and leaving permanent dispatching state
initial_findings.reproduction: No-outputSchema descriptor; structuredContent contains 32 arrays of126 zeros. Result passes65536-byte canonical validation; execute raises CONNECTOR_DATA_LIMIT; detail state dispatching/dispatched=true and advance_one=false
initial_findings.resolution: Entire terminal ledger candidate is bounded before save; oversize result is dropped and compact unknown_effect/CONNECTOR_RESULT_LIMIT is persisted without replay

initial_findings.finding: Parent run control lock held during remote discovery in effect preparation
initial_findings.resolution: Connector preparation is now entirely local; fresh descriptor validation remains before remote execution

initial_findings.finding: Observation timestamp changed at each verification, invalidating identical prior evidence at finish
initial_findings.resolution: Evidence timestamp uses persisted item.updated_at; builder regression test included in independently passing suite

final_assessment: No remaining confirmed blocker in reviewed scope. Owner-session/visibility/provider and descriptor/grant/argument fences, exactly-once ledger dispatch, unknown-effect no-retry handling, public DNS IP pin/TLS hostname, redirect/proxy/cookie restrictions and bounded unsupported-schema rejection were checked.
